-- freescript encrypted loader (12-layer strong encryption)
local bit32 = bit32
if not bit32 then
  -- Fallback for Lua 5.3+ (uses native bitops)
  bit32 = {}
  bit32.band = function(a,b) return a & b end
  bit32.bor = function(a,b) return a | b end
  bit32.bxor = function(a,b,c,d) local r=a~b; if c then r=r~c end; if d then r=r~d end; return r end
  bit32.bnot = function(a) return (~a) & 0xffffffff end
  bit32.lshift = function(a,n) return (a << n) & 0xffffffff end
  bit32.rshift = function(a,n) return (a >> n) & 0xffffffff end
end
local band,bor,bxor,bnot,lsh,rsh = bit32.band,bit32.bor,bit32.bxor,bit32.bnot,bit32.lshift,bit32.rshift
local function rrot(a,n) return bor(rsh(a,n), lsh(a, 32-n)) end
local schar,sbyte,ssub,sconcat = string.char,string.byte,string.sub,table.concat

-- ===== base64 =====
local B64C='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
local B64D={}; for i=1,#B64C do B64D[ssub(B64C,i,i)]=i-1 end
local function b64dec(s)
  s=s:gsub('[^%w%+%/%=]','')
  local out={}; local n=#s
  for i=1,n,4 do
    local a=B64D[ssub(s,i,i)] or 0
    local b=B64D[ssub(s,i+1,i+1)] or 0
    local c=B64D[ssub(s,i+2,i+2)]
    local d=B64D[ssub(s,i+3,i+3)]
    local v = a*262144 + b*4096 + (c or 0)*64 + (d or 0)
    out[#out+1]=schar(math.floor(v/65536)%256)
    if c then out[#out+1]=schar(math.floor(v/256)%256) end
    if d then out[#out+1]=schar(v%256) end
  end
  return sconcat(out)
end

-- ===== SHA-256 =====
local Kc={0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2}

local function sha256(msg)
  local h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8 = 0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19
  local L=#msg
  msg=msg..'\128'
  while (#msg%64)~=56 do msg=msg..'\0' end
  local bl=L*8
  -- 64-bit big-endian length (bl fits in 32 bits for our sizes)
  msg=msg..schar(0,0,0,0, band(rsh(bl,24),0xff), band(rsh(bl,16),0xff), band(rsh(bl,8),0xff), band(bl,0xff))
  local w={}
  for chunk=1,#msg,64 do
    for i=0,15 do
      local o=chunk+i*4
      w[i+1] = lsh(sbyte(msg,o),24) + lsh(sbyte(msg,o+1),16) + lsh(sbyte(msg,o+2),8) + sbyte(msg,o+3)
    end
    for i=17,64 do
      local w15=w[i-15]; local w2=w[i-2]
      local s0=bxor(rrot(w15,7), rrot(w15,18), rsh(w15,3))
      local s1=bxor(rrot(w2,17), rrot(w2,19), rsh(w2,10))
      w[i] = band(w[i-16]+s0+w[i-7]+s1, 0xffffffff)
    end
    local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,hh = h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8
    for i=1,64 do
      local S1 = bxor(rrot(e,6), rrot(e,11), rrot(e,25))
      local ch = bxor(band(e,f), band(bnot(e),g))
      local t1 = band(hh + S1 + ch + Kc[i] + w[i], 0xffffffff)
      local S0 = bxor(rrot(a,2), rrot(a,13), rrot(a,22))
      local mj = bxor(band(a,b), band(a,c), band(b,c))
      local t2 = band(S0 + mj, 0xffffffff)
      hh=g; g=f; f=e; e=band(d+t1,0xffffffff); d=c; c=b; b=a; a=band(t1+t2,0xffffffff)
    end
    h1=band(h1+a,0xffffffff); h2=band(h2+b,0xffffffff); h3=band(h3+c,0xffffffff); h4=band(h4+d,0xffffffff)
    h5=band(h5+e,0xffffffff); h6=band(h6+f,0xffffffff); h7=band(h7+g,0xffffffff); h8=band(h8+hh,0xffffffff)
  end
  local function w4(x) return schar(band(rsh(x,24),0xff),band(rsh(x,16),0xff),band(rsh(x,8),0xff),band(x,0xff)) end
  return w4(h1)..w4(h2)..w4(h3)..w4(h4)..w4(h5)..w4(h6)..w4(h7)..w4(h8)
end

local function sha_ctr(key, n)
  local out={}; local c=0; local total=0
  while total<n do
    -- 8-byte big-endian counter; c fits in 32 bits for our sizes
    local ctr = schar(0,0,0,0, band(rsh(c,24),0xff), band(rsh(c,16),0xff), band(rsh(c,8),0xff), band(c,0xff))
    local h = sha256(key..ctr)
    out[#out+1]=h; total=total+32; c=c+1
  end
  return ssub(sconcat(out),1,n)
end

-- ===== ChaCha20 =====
local function chacha_block(key, nonce, counter)
  local s={0x61707865,0x3320646e,0x79622d32,0x6b206574}
  for i=0,7 do
    local o=1+i*4
    s[5+i] = lsh(sbyte(key,o+3),24) + lsh(sbyte(key,o+2),16) + lsh(sbyte(key,o+1),8) + sbyte(key,o)
  end
  s[13]=counter
  for i=0,2 do
    local o=1+i*4
    s[14+i] = lsh(sbyte(nonce,o+3),24) + lsh(sbyte(nonce,o+2),16) + lsh(sbyte(nonce,o+1),8) + sbyte(nonce,o)
  end
  local x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7,x8,x9,x10,x11,x12,x13,x14,x15,x16 =
    s[1],s[2],s[3],s[4],s[5],s[6],s[7],s[8],s[9],s[10],s[11],s[12],s[13],s[14],s[15],s[16]
  local function q(a,b,c,d)
    a=band(a+b,0xffffffff); d=rrot(bxor(d,a),16)
    c=band(c+d,0xffffffff); b=rrot(bxor(b,c),20)
    a=band(a+b,0xffffffff); d=rrot(bxor(d,a),24)
    c=band(c+d,0xffffffff); b=rrot(bxor(b,c),25)
    return a,b,c,d
  end
  for _=1,10 do
    x1,x5,x9,x13 = q(x1,x5,x9,x13)
    x2,x6,x10,x14 = q(x2,x6,x10,x14)
    x3,x7,x11,x15 = q(x3,x7,x11,x15)
    x4,x8,x12,x16 = q(x4,x8,x12,x16)
    x1,x6,x11,x16 = q(x1,x6,x11,x16)
    x2,x7,x12,x13 = q(x2,x7,x12,x13)
    x3,x8,x9,x14 = q(x3,x8,x9,x14)
    x4,x5,x10,x15 = q(x4,x5,x10,x15)
  end
  local r={band(x1+s[1],0xffffffff),band(x2+s[2],0xffffffff),band(x3+s[3],0xffffffff),band(x4+s[4],0xffffffff),
           band(x5+s[5],0xffffffff),band(x6+s[6],0xffffffff),band(x7+s[7],0xffffffff),band(x8+s[8],0xffffffff),
           band(x9+s[9],0xffffffff),band(x10+s[10],0xffffffff),band(x11+s[11],0xffffffff),band(x12+s[12],0xffffffff),
           band(x13+s[13],0xffffffff),band(x14+s[14],0xffffffff),band(x15+s[15],0xffffffff),band(x16+s[16],0xffffffff)}
  local out={}
  for i=1,16 do
    local v=r[i]
    out[i]=schar(band(v,0xff),band(rsh(v,8),0xff),band(rsh(v,16),0xff),band(rsh(v,24),0xff))
  end
  return sconcat(out)
end

local function chacha20_xor(key, nonce, data)
  local n=#data
  local out={}; local counter=0
  for i=1,n,64 do
    local ks=chacha_block(key,nonce,counter); counter=counter+1
    local endp = i+63; if endp>n then endp=n end
    local buf={}
    for j=i,endp do
      buf[#buf+1] = schar(bxor(sbyte(data,j), sbyte(ks,j-i+1)))
    end
    out[#out+1]=sconcat(buf)
  end
  return sconcat(out)
end

-- ===== helpers =====
local function xor_stream(data, key)
  local ks = sha_ctr(key, #data)
  local out={}
  for i=1,#data do out[i]=schar(bxor(sbyte(data,i), sbyte(ks,i))) end
  return sconcat(out)
end

local function unrot(data, mul, add)
  local out={}
  for i=1,#data do
    local r = band((i-1)*mul+add, 7)
    local b = sbyte(data,i)
    if r==0 then out[i]=schar(b)
    else out[i]=schar(band(bor(rsh(b,r), lsh(b,8-r)), 0xff)) end
  end
  return sconcat(out)
end

local function rev_blocks64(data)
  local out={}
  for i=1,#data,64 do out[#out+1] = ssub(data,i,i+63):reverse() end
  return sconcat(out)
end

local function apply_table(data, tbl)
  local out={}
  for i=1,#data do out[i]=schar(sbyte(tbl, sbyte(data,i)+1)) end
  return sconcat(out)
end

local INV_AES_SBOX=b64dec("")

local N = 348205
local d = b64dec("")
local K1 = b64dec("RrFkuXNE7Prf1kQat/OQcRp7KAYs3We5nr22999hwo4="); local K2 = b64dec("Fi6anSw2ybjhe+UVYRyV1m0Zw4Rlk8ggVcEDsXwQrco="); local K3 = b64dec("fzFTV6qL2m2QQkKyaACpmOgoWxa8+ncm4GlAJR9Xp/s=")
local CK1 = b64dec("1Z3Ywh/5wUXyaDu8w/Ete/dOS9D1pME9nPCHeTFdW74="); local CN1 = b64dec("jaCweMAdll7dFPEQ")
local CK2 = b64dec("dZAxHLjtFJlJeqEBEMlXA5rJA7WSk0mGbq+GG935I9k="); local CN2 = b64dec("ZSZ/yEUBwOAE127J")
local INVPERM = b64dec("")

d = unrot(d, 11, 5)          -- undo L11
d = xor_stream(d, K3)        -- undo L10
d = d:reverse()              -- undo L9
d = chacha20_xor(CK2, CN2, d)-- undo L8
d = apply_table(d, INVPERM)  -- undo L7
d = xor_stream(d, K2)        -- undo L6
d = rev_blocks64(d)          -- undo L5
d = chacha20_xor(CK1, CN1, d)-- undo L4
d = unrot(d, 7, 3)           -- undo L3
d = apply_table(d, INV_AES_SBOX) -- undo L2
d = xor_stream(d, K1)        -- undo L1

local f, err = (loadstring or load)(d)
if not f then error("decrypt failed: "..tostring(err)) end
return f()
